bullets.text: Companywide CR was 86.1; PL CR reached 84.5 (vs. 98.7 in Q1 2023); CL CR was 91.8; Property CR improved 12.1 pts to 93.4, with weather and non-weather losses both contributing.
Companywide NPW +18% YOY; PL NPW rose 20%; CL NPW increased 11%; Property NPW grew 17%, primarily driven by new business application growth and increased retention in focused growth states.

PL loss frequency dropped nearly 9% YOY for both bodily injury and physical damage; 0.7 pts favorable prior year development, over half in Florida following tort reform; Property cat losses fell 5.0 pts.

PL PIF +7% to 26.5M; Property PIF +10% to 3.2M; Direct auto hit record single-day quote volume; phone sales set application records; policy life expectancy achieved ten consecutive months of YOY improvement.

Believes rates are adequate across much of the country; commercial auto rates raised ~17% in 2023 continue earning in; TNC renewed with significant rate increases; Property rates rose ~6% (~17% over four quarters).

Investment portfolio returned 0.8% (fixed income 0.3%, equity 9.9%); took advantage of higher interest rates to increase duration to 3.2 years; redeemed all $500M in preferred shares in light of capital strength.

Auto model 8.9 elevated first state; model 8.8 in 27 states (>60% NPW); commercial auto 8.2 in two states; Property 5.0 in five; BOP launched in Florida, its 45th state (76% commercial multiperil market).

Challenging freight market conditions provided growth headwinds for for-hire transportation BMT, shrinking since Q4 2022 as active motor carriers decreased nearly every month; other commercial targets saw healthy shopping growth.
Due to elevated shopping, reduced non-rate restrictions, and increased media spend, Direct auto tied record Q1 2023 quote volumes and set an all-time single-day quote volume record.

Won Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award for fourth consecutive year; highlighted culture of mutual employee support, community brand ambassadors, and service through the company's newest benefit, volunteer time off.
